tails need head markers too (trailing-copyright ebooks)
strong-anchor requirement prevents genre-content catastrophes (hotel listings, kanji entries)

multi-KB legal blocks with sparse markers (100815 -1646): chain dies mid-block
bibliography line detector too weak (112405: 1.1KB biblio left)
